shortDescription: Manage peers for routing generic message protocol messages

options.name: auto_init
options.description: If C(true), the BIG-IP automatically creates outbound connections to the active pool members in the specified C(pool) using the configuration of the specified C(transport_config). For auto-initialization to attempt to create a connection, the peer must be included in a route that is attached to a router instance. For each router instance the peer is contained in, a connection is initiated. The C(auto_init) logic verifies at C(auto_init_interval) if the a connection exists between the BIG-IP and

options.name: auto_init_interval
options.description: Specifies the interval at which attempts to initiate a connection occur. The default value upon peer object creation, that is supplied by the system is C(5000) milliseconds. The accepted range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: connection_mode
options.description: Specifies how the number of connections per host are to be limited.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the peer.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the peer to manage.

options.name: number_of_connections
options.description: Specifies the distribution of connections between the BIG-IP and a remote host. The accepted range is between 0 and 65535 inclusive.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to create peer object on.

options.name: pool
options.description: Specifies the name of the pool that messages are routed towards. The specified pool must be on the same partition as the peer.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: ratio
options.description: Specifies the ratio to be used for selection of a peer within a list of peers in a LTM route. The accepted range is between 0 and 4294967295 inclusive.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the peer exists. When C(absent), ensures the peer is removed.

options.name: transport_config
options.description: The name of the LTM virtual or LTM transport-config to use for creating an outgoing connection. The resource must exist on the same partition as the peer object.

options.name: type
options.description: Parameter used to specify the type of the peer to manage. Default setting is C(generic) with more options coming.
